proposals.before: When Ziji came home, his son at six inherited the rank, lowered to duke.
proposals.after: His son Jigui, at age six, inherited the title, which was reduced to duke.
proposals.reason: Chinese 子冀歸 names the son Jigui; the idiomatic English misreads 冀歸 as a homecoming verb phrase.

proposals.before: Ziji returned; at age six he inherited the title, which was reduced to duke.
proposals.after: His son Jigui; at age six he inherited the title, which was reduced to duke.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise treats 冀歸 as a verb; it is the personal name Jigui.

proposals.before: On Shizu's campaign against Helian Chang, Daosheng with Changsun Han, Minister of Works, and E Qing, Director of the Imperial Clan, led the van and brought the realm down.
proposals.after: On Shizu's campaign against Helian Chang, Daosheng with Changsun Han, Minister over the Masses, and E Qing, Director of the Imperial Clan, led the van and brought the realm down.
proposals.reason: Chinese 司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Works (司空).

proposals.before: When Shizu campaigned against Helian Chang, Daosheng with Minister of Works Changsun Han and Director of the Imperial Clan E Qing served as vanguard and thereupon pacified the state.
proposals.after: When Shizu campaigned against Helian Chang, Daosheng with Minister over the Masses Changsun Han and Director of the Imperial Clan E Qing served as vanguard and thereupon pacified the state.
proposals.reason: Same 司徒/司空 office mistranslation in the literal line.

proposals.before: He became director of the Masters of Writing, palace attendant, and concurrently minister of writing and grand mobile secretariat, still holding Chang'an.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Minister over the Masses, added attendant-in-ordinary, and concurrently Minister of Writing and grand mobile secretariat, still garrisoning Chang'an.
proposals.reason: 遷司徒公 is Minister over the Masses, not director of the Masters of Writing.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Director of the Masters of Writing, added Palace Attendant, and concurrently Minister of Writing and Grand Mobile Secretariat, still garrisoning Chang'an.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Minister over the Masses, added Palace Attendant, and concurrently Minister of Writing and Grand Mobile Secretariat, still garrisoning Chang'an.
proposals.reason: Literal also mistranslates 司徒公 as Masters of Writing.

proposals.before: Zhi asked to pass the title to his cousin on his mother's side, Grand Minister of Justice Yuan Hongchao's second son Yun.
proposals.after: Zhi asked to transfer the enfeoffment to the second son Yun of his maternal cousin, Grand Minister of Justice Yuan Hongchao.
proposals.reason: 姨兄 is Yuan Hongchao; 次子惲 is Hongchao's son. The idiomatic English conflates Yun with the maternal cousin.

proposals.before: Thereupon he gave Luo's former husband's daughter, the Lu clan, in marriage, and married Xingde's elder brother Xingen to repay him.
proposals.after: Thereupon he married Luo's former husband's daughter of the Lu clan to Xingde's elder brother Xingen in order to repay him.
proposals.reason: Literal English garbles the marriage direction; Zhi gave the Lu daughter to Xingen.

decisions.reason: 子冀歸 names the heir 冀歸 (Jigui); s0102’s 賜名稚 confirms this is a personal name, so “Ziji came home” invents a homecoming verb.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 子冀歸，六歲襲爵，降為公

decisions.after: His son Jigui, at age six, inherited the title, which was reduced to duke.
decisions.reason: 冀歸 is the personal name Jigui, not a return verb, but the proposed “His son Jigui;” is a sentence fragment; a full clause restores the name without the awkward break.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 子冀歸，六歲襲爵，降為公

decisions.reason: 司徒長孫翰 marks Changsun Han’s office as 司徒 (Minister over the Masses), not 司空 (Minister of Works).
The same 司徒 in 司徒長孫翰 is Minister over the Masses; “Minister of Works” is the wrong office title.
遷司徒公 is promotion to Minister over the Masses; 兼尚書令 is the concurrent Masters-of-Writing post, so the before text misassigns 尚書令 to 司徒公.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遷司徒公，加侍中，兼尚書令、大行臺

decisions.reason: Literal likewise reads 遷司徒公 as Masters of Writing; that title belongs to concurrent 尚書令, while 司徒公 is Minister over the Masses.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遷司徒公，加侍中，兼尚書令、大行臺

decisions.reason: 姨兄廷尉卿元洪超 identifies Hongchao as the maternal cousin, and 次子惲 is Hongchao’s second son; the before appositive makes Yun himself the cousin.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其姨兄廷尉卿元洪超次子惲

decisions.reason: 以…呂氏，妻興德兄興恩 means he married the Lu daughter to Xingen; the before splits this into two garbled marriage acts.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以後妻羅前夫女呂氏，妻興德兄興恩以報之
